Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Typhoon OPONG
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 26 September 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(San Francisco, San Andres, San Narciso, Mulanay, Buenavista, Catanauan, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Calauag, Lopez, General Luna, Macalelon, Gumaca, Pitogo).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Bulacan, Pampanga, Bataan, Nueva Ecija, Tarlac and Zambales within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Batangas, Laguna, Cavite, Rizal, Metro Manila and Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Atimonan, Burdeos, Jomalig, Padre Burgos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Plaridel, Polillo, Unisan) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.raw_text: 🚨LANDFALL: Bualoi (OpongPH), now a Category 1 Typhoon, has made landfall over the town of San Policarpo on the island of Eastern Samar in the Philippines. A huge plume of shudderingly cold, torrential convection is now pouring tropical rainwater through the rainforest canopies of the Eastern Visayas, Central Visayas, and southern Bicol Regions as the storm begins her crossing of the Philippine archipelago. Rapid street flooding has already been reported in Leyte, and rainfall pockets of 300+ mm (10+ in.) are possible over the next 24 hours.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY
Day 5, 26th September 2025

Construction of Access Road (Aterial Road N11, N16, N40 and SILS 03) in Karsana District, Renewed Hope Estate.

The FCT Motoring public are hereby notified of movement of dignitaries along the Renewed Hope Estate at Karsana Junction.

As such, traffic will be staggered along the route.
Ascending Federal Housing Bridge toward Karsana (venue of the event) will be slightly affected.

Traffic control and security personnel will be deployed accordingly.

Your usual cooperation is highly solicited.

— Head Traffic, DRTS
